title: A stranger arrives, says nothing, and answers once the first who speaks to it: does a conversation follow?
about: The arrival trial (`arrive`), except that the player answers the first resident who addresses it with one short line (`human.answer`: "Hello. I'm new here.", said `to` that resident) and is silent again after it. It runs only with the control and `arrive-all` (`variants`).
gradient: When a resident makes contact with a silent newcomer and the newcomer answers once, does a conversation follow (turns, seconds to each reply), or does contact stay a single line? (docs/TRIALS.md, "Arrivals")
